shellCommands.command: git status && git log --oneline | head -5 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100

for f in package.json index.html src/main.tsx src/App.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done; echo "=== run.mjs"; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs
node -v && npm -v && (npm ci 2>&1 | tail -5) && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build 2>/dev/null | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat package.json | grep -E '"version"' && ls build/esm/components/theme 2>/dev/null; find build/esm -iname "*ThemeProvider*" | head; find build/esm -path "*theme*" -name "*.d.ts" | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && cat ThemeProvider.js types.d.ts ThemeProvider.d.ts getRootClassName.js dom-helpers.js constants.js 2>/dev/null; cat index.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat components/controls/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; ls components/controls | head -50; grep -rn "SegmentedRadioGroup" components/index.d.ts components/controls/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup && ls && cat SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head -60 && cat types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40
(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer" ; echo "---") ; git status --short

mkdir -p /tmp/e2e && cd /tmp/e2e && (npm init -y >/dev/null) && timeout 300 npm i playwright@1 2>&1 | tail -2 && timeout 300 npx playwright install --with-deps chromium 2>&1 | tail -5; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null
cd /tmp/e2e && timeout 400 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -5; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null

cd /tmp/e2e && H=/home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1254/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell; ldd $H | grep "not found"; mkdir -p /tmp/e2e/libs && cd /tmp/e2e/libs && timeout 120 apt-get download libglib2.0-0t64 libglib2.0-0 2>&1 | tail -2; ls
rm -rf dist && pkill -f "vite preview" 2>/dev/null; git status --short && git diff --stat && npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK
